note: Every file that could be re-fetched hashed to the sha256 the manifest records and was judged identically, so the corrected adapter leaves the third-party verdicts as measured. The 18 that could not be re-fetched were sha256-verified when collected and cannot be re-verified now; the measurement stands on that earlier verification.
what_this_is: A re-fetch of the third-party Kyverno corpus at the commits its manifest records, run after the adapter's external-context test was moved off raw text onto the parsed document. It answers two questions: whether that fix changes any third-party verdict, and whether a corpus collected by code search can still be fetched later.
